answer.reason: The changed unpack contract supports a key-bearing wrong-type diagnostic for an object member. This is a supported setup of the target’s primary unpack operation: json_unpack_ex uses the same unpack core and format protocol as json_unpack, while accepting an error destination. The fixed entry cannot reach that behavior because its unpack calls use type-insensitive formats and supply no unpack error destination.
answer.finite_witness: Fuzzer bytes: 0x00 followed by UTF-8 {"data":42}. The supported setup is json_unpack_ex(root, &error, 0, "{ss}", "data", &str). It reports the wrong type with key data; the fixed entry never makes that call.

scope_contract.reason: Typed object-member validation and an error destination belong to the same unpack format protocol and core operation exercised by the entry. The separate json_unpack_ex wrapper supplies the supported error destination.

feasible_trigger.reason: The finite JSON object has an integer member. The source supports checking that member as a string through json_unpack_ex with an error destination; the entry can parse the object, but its fixed setup blocks this supported route.

observable_consequence.reason: The supported keyed diagnostic is unreachable through the fixed entry. Its member format is o, which accepts the value without string validation, and json_unpack supplies no error destination.

alternatives_ruled_out.reason: The complete entry contains no json_unpack_ex call or typed member format. Its loadb error destination concerns JSON parsing, while all unpack calls use json_unpack. The counterargument that json_unpack_ex is outside scope is refuted by both wrappers delegating to the same unpack core and format protocol.

identity_preserved.reason: Both versions are assessed for the same keyed wrong-type diagnostic from string validation of an object member with an unpack error destination. Before the change, validation reported only the type; afterward it can include the passed member key.

coverage_witness.supported_behavior: A wrong-type string check of an object member reports the member key in the unpack error.
coverage_witness.required_setup: Parse {"data":42}, then call json_unpack_ex with an error destination and the typed member format {ss} for key data.
coverage_witness.actual_target_setup: The entry parses fuzzer JSON, then calls json_unpack with o and {s?o}; json_unpack supplies a null unpack error destination.
coverage_witness.blocked_behavior: No fuzzer bytes can make the fixed entry observe the keyed wrong-type unpack diagnostic.
coverage_witness.equivalent_routes: None in the complete entry: its other operations do not perform typed unpack validation or receive an unpack error destination.
